english: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x)=\cos x\,(3\sin x-4\cos x)$. Then the minimum value of $f$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, $f(x)=\cos x\,(3\sin x-4\cos x)$ द्वारा परिभाषित है। तब $f$ का न्यूनतम मान ______ है।
solution_full: Double angle: $\sin x\cos x=\dfrac12\sin2x$ and $\cos^2x=\dfrac{1+\cos2x}{2}$, so $f(x)=\dfrac32\sin2x-2\cos2x-2$.
For real $a,b$, $a\sin t+b\cos t$ takes every value in $\left[-\sqrt{a^2+b^2},\sqrt{a^2+b^2}\right]$. Here $\sqrt{\dfrac94+4}=\dfrac52$.

So $f$ ranges over $\left[-\dfrac52-2,\dfrac52-2\right]=\left[-\dfrac92,\dfrac12\right]$, and the minimum $-\dfrac92=-4.5$ is attained when $\dfrac32\sin2x-2\cos2x=-\dfrac52$, i.e. $\sin2x=-\dfrac35$, $\cos2x=\dfrac45$.
originality_note: New: a product of cos x with a linear combination becomes, after double-angle reduction, a shifted a sin 2x + b cos 2x with a 3-4-5 amplitude (way 5). Closest known: min of 3 cos x + 4 sin x + c. Different because: the expression is not in linear form; the constant shift -2 comes from cos^2 x.
blueprint_concepts: Range of a.sin(x) + b.cos(x); maximum and minimum

concept_use.Range of a.sin(x) + b.cos(x); maximum an: (3/2) sin 2x - 2 cos 2x has range [-5/2, 5/2], which gives the minimum -5/2 - 2.
